page.layout: One page of text in a single column; page number "34" at the top left; running head at the top, illegible; "III." printed at the foot right.

main_text.p: admodum planius aliquanto pòft intelligetur: quanta il lorū dignitas, auctoritas, am plitudoque fuerit, non difficile intellectu eft. At uero a-pud Græcos, ceterasque gentes, huiusce præclari muneris, ut anté dixi, mentio nulla eft prorsus. Quapropter qui apud illos fefe priuatorū negotijs rebusque agedis [?] interponebat, ij non Iurisconsulti, sed Pragmatici, quasi dicas negotiosi, & formularij, no-minabatur: homines (ut ait apud Ciceronē Crassus) infimi, & mercenarij: qui se mi-nistros in iudicijs oratorib. præbebat. Itaque Fabius lib.

page.notes: The running head is in black-letter style and too faint to read. The word "am" at the end of the line before "plitudoque" is set apart from it by a dot. "agedis" and "ij" are doubtful readings. The "III." at the foot is treated as the gathering signature.
